The daily work of fabric and apparel patternmakers centers on pattern accuracy and material efficiency: determining style structure and garment part divisions from design drawings and specifications, then drawing and constructing master patterns; grading up and down across a size range and verifying key measurement points; calculating material usage and laying out garment parts to reduce waste, marking and cutting fabric when needed; verifying the pattern by making sample garments and fitting them, recording problems, and correcting the pattern; and confirming design intent with designers, confirming sewing and process feasibility with production, and maintaining pattern files and specification sheets.
